notes: Paper searches for resonant conversion of dark photon dark matter into radio waves in the solar corona using LOFAR data, 30-80 MHz (mA' ~ 1.2e-7 to 3.3e-7 eV). Main result is epsilon ~ 1e-13. Data points are approximate readings from Fig. 4 (the exclusion curve is jagged; representative values given). A subdominant axion-photon limit is also derived (Fig. 10) but is not competitive; the dark photon limit is the primary result. Mass range corresponds to plasma frequencies 30-80 MHz mapping to ~1.2e-7 to 3.3e-7 eV, though the plot x-axis extends 1-6 x1e-7 eV. | selector: text (sole candidate)
